title: SQL Power Recipes
description: Advanced SQL patterns — CTEs, window functions, UPSERT, JSON, aggregation, and performance tips.

entries.label: Common Table Expression
entries.description: Use CTEs for readable multi-step queries — like temporary named subqueries

entries.label: Window: Row Number
entries.command:
SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rank
FROM employees;
entries.description: Rank rows within groups without collapsing the result set

entries.label: Window: Running Total
entries.description: Calculate a cumulative sum ordered by date

entries.label: UPSERT (Insert or Update)
entries.command:
INSERT INTO items (id, name, value)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  value = EXCLUDED.value,
  updated_at = NOW();
entries.description: Insert a row or update it if a conflict on the unique key occurs

entries.label: JSON Query (Postgres)
entries.command:
SELECT id, metadata->>'author' AS author,
  metadata->'tags' AS tags
FROM items
WHERE metadata @> '{"language": "go"}';
entries.description: Query JSONB columns — extract fields and filter by JSON content

entries.label: Lateral Join
entries.description: Get the top N related rows per parent row (like a correlated subquery on steroids)

entries.label: Conditional Aggregation
entries.command:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active') AS active,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'inactive') AS inactive
FROM users;
entries.description: Aggregate different conditions in a single query pass (Postgres FILTER)

entries.label: Generate Date Series
entries.description: Fill gaps in time-series data — no missing days in charts

entries.label: Index Usage Check
entries.command:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT TEXT)
SELECT * FROM items WHERE url_normalized = 'example.com/repo';
entries.description: Check if your query uses indexes — look for 'Index Scan' vs 'Seq Scan'

entries.label: Bulk Delete with Returning
entries.description: Delete rows and return what was deleted in one atomic operation
